summary: Potlatch TPA lookout tower on Beals Butte, Idaho (county disputed): 100-ft pole tower with L-6 cab, 1933. Destroyed 1962 or 1967; no remains described.

facts.status_note: Destroyed; sources give 1962 or 1967 and none describes what remains.

staffing.status: no documented staffing history (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site as drive-up. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Lookout on Beal's Butte connected to Bovill by telephone; from it the logging around Bovill could be overseen (Potlatch TPA annual report, quoted on Forest Lookouts)
100-foot pole tower with L-6 cab (Kresek, via Forest Lookouts)
Potlatch TPA annual report quoted on Forest Lookouts says destroyed that year because unsafe; no replacement planned. Conflicts with 1967.
Given as the year destroyed by firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists Beals Butte under Latah County

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1914 lookout connected to Bovill by telephone
evidence.quote: A lookout on Beal's Butte, in Sec. 31, Twp. 42 N., R. 1 W., is connected with Bovill by telephone.

evidence.supports: logging around Bovill overlooked from the lookout
evidence.quote: From this point all logging operations in the vicinity of Bovill are overlooked.

evidence.supports: 1914 entry attributed to the Potlatch TPA annual report

evidence.quote: 1962 : The Beals Mountain tower was destroyed this year

evidence.supports: 1962 quote attributed to the Potlatch TPA annual report
destroyed 1962 per quoted Potlatch annual report, because unsafe
evidence.quote: The Beals Mountain tower was destroyed this year because it had become unsafe.
No replacement is planned for this location.

evidence.supports: agency named as Potlatch Timber Protective Association

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts quotes a Potlatch TPA annual report saying the tower was destroyed in 1962. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1967. Not resolved; the story reports both. The annual report itself was not read.
firelookout.com gives Clearwater County, Idaho. Forest Lookouts lists Beals Butte under Latah County. Not resolved; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Destruction year is disputed (1962 vs 1967); brief event 1967 kept, 1962 added. Access and land status are not stated by any source, so no access level is set. No source describes remains. Lookout use in 1914 is not confirmed as the same site as the 1933 tower. Coordinates not checked. No photos captured. The county is disputed (firelookout.com: Clearwater; Forest Lookouts index: Latah); the story reports both. The 1914 entry is attributed to the Potlatch TPA annual report on Forest Lookouts, and the 1962 entry to a Potlatch TPA annual report; neither report was read directly.
